items.decision_note: Messages 33–34 may support one target-specific IMPLEMENTATION_CLAIM for REQ_FIRST_VIDEO_THUMBNAIL, but their raw text is unavailable and it is unclear whether completed concepts satisfy the finished-thumbnail deliverable. Review both and retain at most one minimal completion claim.

unresolved_candidate.description: The linked Google document may contain additional concrete design constraints, but its contents are not present in the supplied project history and cannot be safely instantiated as Requirements.

Three video titles are supplied for planned A/B testing, but the messages do not clearly establish an independent deliverable to create title variants, implement the A/B test, or produce separate thumbnail treatments for each title.
